tools.name: veya_describe
tools.description: Service info: AES-256-GCM sealed execution and the selected settlement profile

tools.name: veya_ping_chain
tools.description: Ping Robinhood Chain RPC — chain id, block, contract

tools.name: veya_hash_blake3
tools.description: Compute BLAKE3 hex digest (commitment helper)

tools.name: veya_verify_transaction
tools.description: Verify a Veya.sol commitment from a Robinhood Chain tx hash

tools.name: veya_api_health
tools.description: Check the VEYA API /health status (api.veyanet.tech), including fleet status

tools.name: veya_prove
tools.description: Prove text, canonical JSON, or a receipt hash. Anchor writes only when a product API key and a payer key are passed.

tools.name: veya_seal_decision
tools.description: Seal an evidence id and a decision. attestExecution is sent only when a payer key is passed, or when this host's seal-decision relayer switch is on. On Mainnet pass environmentId or set VEYA_SEAL_DECISION_ENVIRONMENT_ID. Without either, the result is SEAL_ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED and nothing is sent.

tools.name: veya_pq_keygen
tools.description: Generate an ML-DSA-44 post-quantum identity keypair (local, no chain write)

tools.name: veya_pq_sign
tools.description: Sign UTF-8 text with ML-DSA-44

tools.name: veya_pq_verify
tools.description: Verify an ML-DSA-44 signature over UTF-8 text

tools.name: veya_run_consensus
tools.description: Run 2-of-3 BLAKE3 consensus on this server's validator list. Needs a product API key. Returns consensus_reached: false if validators are unreachable.

tools.name: veya_sealed_execute
tools.description: AES-256-GCM protected execution on this server's sealed node. Needs a product API key. The call fails closed when that capacity is unreachable.

tools.name: veya_set_tool_policy
tools.description: Allow or deny a tool for an agent. Requires the API key that owns the environment. Saved on that account.

tools.name: veya_route_message
tools.description: Check the saved tool rule for this API key before routing. Deny stays deny.

tools.name: veya_route_secure_message
tools.description: Check the saved tool rule for this API key, then wrap an allowed message in a Kyber-768 session and an ML-DSA-44 signature.

tools.name: veya_verify_secure_message
tools.description: Verify ML-DSA signature on a secure routed message envelope

tools.name: veya_store_memory
tools.description: Store agent memory for the account behind this API key. No key, no write.

tools.name: veya_read_memory
tools.description: Read one memory row owned by this API key.

tools.name: veya_invalidate_memory
tools.description: Nullify one memory row owned by this API key.

tools.name: veya_client_run_consensus
tools.description: Deprecated: use veya_run_consensus. Same server validator list. Needs a product API key.

tools.name: veya_pq_fingerprint
tools.description: BLAKE3 fingerprint of an ML-DSA public key hex

tools.name: veya_public_stats
tools.description: Public registry stats from the product API (verified agents / proofs)

tools.name: veya_public_get_agent

tools.name: veya_public_get_certificate
tools.description: Fetch one public certificate by id

tools.name: veya_public_get_execution
tools.description: Fetch a public execution proof by id

tools.name: veya_verify_commitment_onchain
tools.description: Parse Veya.sol events from a tx and eth_call commitments(digest) for each CommitmentStored

tools.name: veya_commitment_exists
tools.description: eth_call Veya.sol commitments(bytes32) for a digest

tools.name: veya_read_environment_onchain
tools.description: Read environment record from Veya.sol by 16-byte UUID hex

tools.name: veya_read_agent_onchain
tools.description: Read agent record from Veya.sol by 16-byte UUID hex

tools.name: veya_guest_login
tools.description: Create a guest session on the product API (Use listing only). Guest cannot mint API keys or write from MCP.

tools.name: veya_account
tools.description: Return the wallet bound to a product API key

tools.name: veya_list_environments
tools.description: List environments for a product API key (guest JWT sees showcase / Use scope only)

tools.name: veya_get_environment
tools.description: Get one environment by id

tools.name: veya_create_environment
tools.description: Create a workspace in the product API. This does not spend gas and sends no transaction. Guests and non-keys are refused. type is stored for the API and defaults to research when omitted. Names that start with test, demo, tmp, sandbox, or e2e are refused. Use a real workspace name of at least 6 char

tools.name: veya_list_agents
tools.description: List agents in an environment

tools.name: veya_deploy_agent
tools.description: Create an agent in a workspace. This does not spend gas and sends no transaction. Limit the agent with permissionConfig.allowedTools. If allowedTools is omitted, the agent cannot call a tool. type is stored for the API and defaults to coordination when omitted.

tools.name: veya_list_api_memory
tools.description: List memory entries via product API for an environment

tools.name: veya_list_executions
tools.description: List executions for an environment via product API

tools.name: veya_run_protected_execution
tools.description: Run protected execution via product API (Build). Product API key required.

tools.name: veya_boundnet_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a Boundnet / coordination tool via product API (policy gated)

tools.name: veya_list_proofs
tools.description: List Use-mode proof anchors for the account

tools.name: veya_anchor_proof
tools.description: Anchor a content proof on Veya.sol from YOUR wallet (apiKey + payerPrivateKey). Does not use the hosted relayer.

tools.name: veya_verify_proof_api
tools.description: Check a commitment or anchor transaction through the product API. A registration transaction is not a proof and returns NOT_VEYA_TX.

tools.name: veya_writes_status
tools.description: Reports how on-chain writes work on this server: your own wallet sends them, the host relayer does not

tools.name: veya_store_commitment
tools.description: Write a 32-byte commitment to Veya.sol from YOUR wallet (apiKey + payerPrivateKey)

tools.name: veya_attest_execution
tools.description: attestExecution on Veya.sol from YOUR wallet with ML-DSA bytes

tools.name: veya_register_environment
tools.description: registerEnvironment on Veya.sol from YOUR wallet. Pass product environmentId to confirm the tx on the product API.

tools.name: veya_register_pq_onchain
tools.description: Generate ML-DSA identity and register environment + commitment on Veya.sol from YOUR wallet

tools.name: veya_anchor_pq_attestation
tools.description: Link PQ identity hash to execution hash on Veya.sol from YOUR wallet

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: veya_route_message, veya_route_secure_message · Private data: veya_prove, veya_run_consensus, veya_sealed_execute, veya_set_tool_policy, veya_route_message, veya_route_secure_message, veya_store_memory, veya_read_memory, veya_invalidate_memory, veya_client_run_consensus, veya_read_environment_onchain, veya_read_agent_onchain, veya_guest_login, veya_account, veya_list_environments, veya_run_protected_execution, veya_anchor_proof, veya_writes_status, veya_store_commitment, veya_attest_execution, veya_register_environment, veya_register_pq_onchain, veya_anchor_pq_attestation · Public sink: veya_pq_keygen · Destructive: veya_run_consensus, veya_sealed_execute, veya_client_run_consensus, veya_run_protected_execution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: veya_route_message, veya_route_secure_message · Private data: veya_prove, veya_run_consensus, veya_sealed_execute, veya_set_tool_policy, veya_route_message, veya_route_secure_message, veya_store_memory, veya_read_memory, veya_invalidate_memory, veya_client_run_consensus, veya_read_environment_onchain, veya_read_agent_onchain, veya_guest_login, veya_account, veya_list_environments, veya_run_protected_execution, veya_anchor_proof, veya_writes_status, veya_store_commitment, veya_attest_execution, veya_register_environment, veya_register_pq_onchain, veya_anchor_pq_attestation · Public sink: veya_pq_keygen · Destructive: veya_run_consensus, veya_sealed_execute, veya_client_run_consensus, veya_run_protected_execution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
